name: TAG
doc: The current value of a field the service decodes.

name: AND
doc: True when every argument is true.

name: OR
doc: True when at least one argument is true.

name: NOT
doc: The opposite of a true or false value.

name: CHANGED
doc: True in the evaluation where the value became different from the last one known. The first reading is not a change.

name: STALE
doc: True when the value did not change for the whole duration. A value the service cannot read is stale at once.

name: PREV
doc: The value the field held before its last change.

name: SINCE
doc: How many seconds passed since the field last changed.

name: RATE
doc: How fast the value changes, per hour, across the window.

name: AVG
doc: The mean of the readings in the window.

name: MIN
doc: The smallest reading in the window.

name: MAX
doc: The largest reading in the window. It keeps a peak that one poll on its own would miss.

name: COUNT
doc: How many readings the window holds.

name: DELTA
doc: The newest reading minus the oldest one in the window.

name: STDDEV
doc: How much the readings in the window spread around their mean.

name: ZSCORE
doc: How unusual the current reading is against the window. Three or more sits far outside the usual range.

name: SLOPE
doc: The trend of the window, per hour. It fits a line through every reading, so noise moves it less than RATE.

name: FORECAST
doc: Where the value lands after the horizon, if the trend of the window holds.

name: EWMA
doc: A smoothed value that follows the field. Recent readings weigh more, and the time constant says how fast older ones stop counting.

name: BITAND
doc: The bits that are set in both numbers.

name: BITOR
doc: The bits that are set in either number.

name: BITXOR
doc: The bits that are set in one number but not the other.

name: HEX2DEC
doc: The number a hexadecimal text stands for.
